lines: He indeed here is forbidden, not walls-insects-birds; then stone-like
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa evātra niṣiddho no kuḍyakīṭapatatriṇaḥ tarhi pāṣāṇatulyo@sau vilīnendriyavṛttikaḥ
